 Sydney Sweeney’s $49 SYRN Knit Micro Shorts Get an Unexpected Accessory
 RealityTea Follow Shruti Saraogi Wed, October 28, 2026 at 7:36 AM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Wed, October 28, 2026 at 7:36 AM UTC Photo Credit: @sydney_sweeney / Instagram Sydney Sweeney adds an unexpected yet adorable accessory to SYRN's knit micro shorts for the brand's holiday campaign: a small, fluffy white dog. In the clip, she cradles the pup, who wears a cozy sweater of its own, while dressed in burgundy knit. The post promotes the Hibernation Nation collection, with early access open as The Holiday Shop launches.
 Sydney Sweeney adds unexpected yet adorable accessory to SYRN knit micro shorts for holiday campaign
 Sydney Sweeney para a nova coleção 'Holiday' da SYRN. pic.twitter.com/BmE35ENdOB 
 — Sydney Sweeney Brasil (@sydneysbrs) October 27, 2026 
 The shorts that is worn by Sydney Sweeney are the Wine About It Cable Knit Foldover Short, priced at $49 on SYRN's website . The brand describes a plush, braided cable knit with ribbed detailing at the bottom and waistband. Moreover, the oversized foldover waistband lets the wearer adjust the rise, giving the short a cheeky silhouette.
 The brand pairs the shorts with the Cable Knit Cropped Tank . In the product photos, the matching top is a wine-colored cropped tank with a V neckline and wide straps. Meanwhile, in the clip, Sweeney wears the burgundy knit top with $59 Cable Knit Cardigan .
 Advertisement Advertisement Her long, golden-blonde hair falls in loose waves over her shoulder as she turns her head to the side. The setting is a cozy room with sheer curtains and floral wallpaper. However, the star accessory is a small, fluffy white dog with floppy ears. The pup wears a cream knit sweater with plaid trim at the collar. Sweeney holds it close in both arms as it looks off to the side.
 Additionally, SYRN's website sells a Cable Knit Dog Sweater for $29. The dog in the video wears it in the Sugar Cookie shade. SYRN shares the clip on Instagram with the caption "The Holiday Shop is officially open" and invites shoppers to explore Hibernation Nation early access. After 16 hours, the post has 62K likes and almost 400 comments full of heart-eyed, fire, and heart emojis.
 Overall, the campaign leans into easy, comfortable styling. Burgundy cable knit, a sweater-clad dog, and a warm room give the holiday launch a cozy, playful feel.
